name: Ferienwohnung Eschengrund
beschreibung: The Ferienwohnung Eschengrund is located in the municipality of Thiersee in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The quiet location on the edge of the village offers a view of the Kaisergebirge. The Thiersee is within walking distance. In summer, the area is ideal for hiking and walks. In winter, the nearby ski area attracts winter sports enthusiasts. The apartment has a fitted kitchen and a balcony with a mountain view. It is a suitable accommodation for couples and small families seeking relaxation in the mountains.
